content: Per Microsoft about_Character_Encoding: Windows PowerShell 5.1 'Out-File/Set-Content -Encoding UTF8' always writes a BOM; default read encoding for BOM-less files (Get-Content -Raw) is the ANSI codepage (Windows-1252 on Western hosts), mangling UTF-8 accents into mojibake; PS 5.1 also parses BOM-less .ps1 scripts as ANSI. PowerShell 7+ defaults to utf8NoBOM everywhere. Any pt-br accents written/read by the .ps1 twins must pin encodings explicitly on both directions.
